description: The DSSAT R interface supports programmatic access to the DSSAT Cropping Systems Model and its inputs and outputs. The cited provider is DSSAT R package authors. The model domain and scenario period depend on the user-defined system and inputs; geographic validation and numerical resolution are not established here. The package registry provides public package metadata and documentation links. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later, read from the CRAN package metadata on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Documentation does not establish completeness, calibration quality or suitability for a particular simulation. For infrastructure simulation, it can inform irrigation-demand or agricultural water-management scenarios. Related by subject to model-fao-cropwat; this comparison does not assert tested interoperability.
